mapper.select: SELECT id, part_sn, part_type, status, bind_status, current_frame_sn, qc_status FROM bike_part WHERE part_sn = #{partSn} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_vehicle_part_binding(vehicle_id, frame_sn, part_id, part_sn, part_type, bind_operator_id, bind_reason, is_current) VALUES(#{vehicleId}, #{frameSn}, #{partId}, #{partSn}, #{partType}, #{operatorId}, CONCAT('组装操作员:', #{operatorName}), 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_part SET bind_status = 'BOUND', current_vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}, current_frame_sn = #{frameSn}, status = 'IN_USE' WHERE id = #{partId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND bind_status = 'UNBOUND'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_operation_log(business_type, business_id, action, frame_sn, operator_id, operator_name, before_data, after_data, client_ip, remark) VALUES('ASSEMBLE', #{businessId}, #{action}, #{frameSn}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, JSON_OBJECT('status', '待组装'), JSON_OBJECT('status', '组装完成'), #{clientIp}, #{remark})
